HediffDef.label: hemopump
HediffDef.description: A synthetic pump that circulates the android's red synthetic blood across all subsystems.

HediffDef.label: hemofilter
HediffDef.description: A synthetic filter that cleans and recycles the android's red synthetic blood.

HediffDef.label: data bus
HediffDef.description: A solid-state data and power bus that routes signals and current through the frame. With no fluid to move, it takes the place of a pump.

HediffDef.label: heatsink
HediffDef.description: A passive, mechanite-laced heatsink that dissipates waste heat directly, with no fluid to filter or recycle.

HediffDef.label: fluid reprocessor
HediffDef.description: A compact reprocessor that recovers and recycles the small amounts of residual lubricants and working fluids within an otherwise dry frame.
